answer: Audits are recorded in umber, queued in ledge, and pearl publishes the wait time. A farm of 370 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 29 identities per epoch. A farm of 4616 identities would post 4577 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
